newsitem.title: USA: Mednet says Nasdaq may delist stock.
newsitem.headline: Mednet says Nasdaq may delist stock.

text.p: Mednet MPC Corp, a provider of managed prescription care services, said Nasdaq may delist the company's shares because it does not meet the necessary requirements to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
In a statement, the company did not say which rules it was not meeting, nor did it say what actions it was taking to be in compliance. A company official was not immediately available to comment.
In addition, Mednet said it has hired the accounting firm of Cairns, Haack, Eng and Applegate,LLP as its new accounting firm.
Mednet said Cairns, Haack will immediately begin the company's year-end audit for 1996's financial results.
In mid-April, Mednet ended its relationship with former accountants McGladrey & Pullen.
